brief:
Middle East Eye cautioned against celebrating Palestinian electoral advances within Israel's political system, noting that parliamentary representation does not negate an apartheid regime or eliminate discriminatory laws. The outlet highlighted that the existence of Palestinian lawmakers fails to address systemic inequalities embedded in Israel's legal framework.

Analysts stressed that electoral participation, while symbolically important, cannot substitute for substantive changes to discriminatory policies and structures affecting Palestinian citizens.

title: Palestinian electoral gains in Israel warrant caution despite representation
